2) Are there any redlines on inference environment (VPC only, sensitive prompts we should strip)?
3) Are you available for a 30-45m technical alignment next week to lock the PoC plan? I’m proposing Tue/Wed mornings PT.

Thanks — I’ll loop in Rishi from eng for any version/pinning questions and Laura from CS for rollout and success criteria.

2) If we decide to halt/rollback the new variant in our environment, what options do we have for pinning to a prior model id? Is rollback fast or does it require infra changes?

We’re happy to jump on a call — this is fairly urgent for us as it affects a customer pilot scheduled for next week.

Thanks,
Jane

Folks —

Quick engineering readout / suggested plan we can present on the triage call with Acme: 

1) Regression diff notes (from preliminary report)
- The largest deltas look stemming from tokenization changes and a prompt-conditioning regression when sequence length exceeds ~1.2k tokens.
- Model variant mismatch: the July rollout included "mistral-7b@v1.3-optim" which applies a slightly different sampling temperature schedule. That explains improved diversity but reduced exact-match in some intents.

2) Immediate mitigation options
- Pin route to previous stable model id: model_id = "mistral-7b@v1.2". This is a configuration change (no infra rollout) and we can flip it in <15 minutes from our control plane.
- Canary traffic: if they want to test variants, use 5-10% traffic canary with automatic rollback conditions (we can tie to exact-match drop threshold).
- Prompt adjustments: team can supply a small targeted prompt-set for in-harness fine-tuning of temperature/top-k; lower-risk but takes 24-48 hours to iterate.

3) Recommended next steps for the call
- Offer immediate pin to v1.2 as a stop-gap while we run a targeted eval on the attached prompt_set_v1.txt.
- If Acme wants to continue with v1.3-optim, propose 2-week canary with monitoring (metrics + human checks).

Action items
- Marissa: confirm call time with Acme and get sign-off for an immediate pin if needed.
- Neha: prep contract note for SLA impacts if we do a nonstandard rollback window.
- Laura: prepare escalation playbook and CS comms template.

Rishi
